summary: Mistral announced an expanded global strategic partnership with Microsoft, including a multi-billion dollar commitment used to accelerate the build-out of Mistral's AI infrastructure.

mechanisms.reason: A multi-billion dollar commitment from Microsoft is explicitly tied to accelerating construction of AI infrastructure.
mechanisms.quote: With this multi-billion dollar commitment from Microsoft, we're accelerating the construction of our AI

mechanisms.reason: A large capital commitment from Microsoft changes Mistral's ability to fund future compute build-out.
